The multi-select question widget requires navigating past all options to a 'Submit' row; on the first question it was easy to mistake Enter-on-an-option as submitting. Minor friction.
Spec date in filename/doc is 2026-09-16 while the run timestamp is 20260917T02... (UTC) — off-by-one-day date derivation likely timezone-related.
